title: Enhancing Energy-Awareness in Deep Learning through Fine-Grained Energy Measurement
reasoning: The paper focuses on measuring energy consumption for Deep Learning models to promote "Green AI principles" and "sustainable AI systems." While these concepts have ethical implications related to environmental sustainability, the paper does not involve evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics as its primary focus or a core component of its methodology.
